subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What are the main types of concerns patients come in with in these visit notes?

judge.implied_focus: The clinical nature/type of the patient's presenting concern (categorizing what each visit is about, by body system, episode type, and severity)

per_column.name: primary_clinical_object
per_column.rationale: Directly types the concern by clinical body-system/category, which is the core of 'main types of concerns' -- the strongest realization of the focus.

per_column.name: severity_or_impact
per_column.rationale: A coherent facet of a presenting concern: how serious/impactful it is, differentiating types of concerns along severity.

per_column.name: visit_episode_type
per_column.rationale: Characterizes the concern as acute/chronic/preventive, a meaningful facet of what type of concern is being presented.

per_column.name: acuity_class
per_column.rationale: Routine/Urgent/Emergency largely restates the existing 'urgency' column and overlaps with severity; adds little distinct concern-typing signal.

per_column.name: clinical_domain
per_column.rationale: Department/specialty (General Practice, Pediatrics...) mostly duplicates the existing 'department' column and correlates with primary_clinical_object rather than adding an independent facet of the concern itself.

judge.rationale: The columns collectively center on one coherent, data-inferable focus: characterizing the type of presenting clinical concern. primary_clinical_object, severity_or_impact, and visit_episode_type form a genuine multi-facet decomposition (what/how-severe/what-kind-of-episode) at useful granularity, directly serving the 'main types of concerns' query and giving an analyst actionable categories. Structure quality is dented because acuity_class and clinical_domain are near-duplicates of the pre-existing urgency and department columns and correlate with the primary categorization rather than adding independent, differentiating facets -- so the set is slightly padded with redundant restatements. Overall a solid, actionable focus with a somewhat diluted structure.
